DALLAS — Belinda Lord went 3-of-4 from the floor and knocked down both of her 3s, leading McMurry to a 52-39 Women's Basketball Invitational semifinal victory over Randolph-Macon.
Tierra Alexander contributed to the War Hawks (8-4), who scored the first eight points of the game.
